rows.needed: Every geometric Hom between the L-defined conjugate factors which is fixed by G_L descends to L.
rows.derivation: A given algebraic morphism between these finite-type L-schemes is defined over some finite extension; enlarge it to finite Galois M/L. Its G_L invariance gives equality of all Galois conjugates over M. Since M tensor_L M is the product of copies of M indexed by Gal(M/L), this is precisely equality of the two pullbacks over the fpqc overlap. The representable-sheaf property descends the morphism uniquely to L. It remains a group homomorphism because the group-law equality can be checked after the same faithfully flat extension.
rows.boundary: Source and target must already be defined over L, and invariance must hold for the entire G_L action. This input does not construct L, prove its degree/unramifiedness, or supply the preceding direct-sum identification.
